text:
sam: Heads-up 1: UX sync note on the latency panel. Spent 10m with QA and found two recurring confusions: the sampling label isn't obvious, and the scrubber handle is hard to hit on laptop trackpads.

tara: noted. for sampling labelling can we be explicit: `Sampling: 1% (approx. 1 in 100 requests)`? avoids math for PMs.

dia: scrubber hit area - we can increase the invisible hit target to 24px and keep the visual thumb small. That usually fixes trackpad problems without changing layout.

sam: good. what about the p95 microcopy? testers expected the stat to be average. We need to show both p50 + p95 side-by-side or call out "p95 (95th percentile)" inline.

tara: side-by-side could be noisy. how about condensed: `p50 / p95: 42ms / 121ms` on one line under the main metric. less room, still clear.

dia: UX accessibility: that line must be semantic text (not aria-hidden). Also ensure the slash has role=separator for screen readers? Maybe use visually-hidden labels: `screenreader: p50 42 ms, p95 121 ms`.

sam: scrubber keyboard interactions: left/right arrows step by 1s, shift+arrow steps by 1m, home/end to start/end. Should we communicate this in a tooltip?

tara: yes, tooltip on focus: `Arrows: step 1s · Shift+arrow: 1m · Home/End: jump`. keep it short.

dia: heatmap color: current deep-blue -> bright-red feels decoupled from other dashboards. Propose earthy ramp: slate -> gold -> burnt-sienna. I'll throw hexes in Figma.

sam: small prototype ask: overlay the p95 line with a 2px dashed stroke when heat-overlay is enabled so it remains legible. Also allow a toggle in the cog to "Show percentile line".

tara: for mobile: hide overlay by default and place a mini sparkline above the heatmap. fewer collisions.

dia: accessibility checklist I'll run: contrast, keyboard targets, focus order, screenreader labels. Will post checklist and a PR with token changes.

uxbot: @sam prototype snapshot available: https://staging.redwood.dev/ux/latency/1981239999. Includes increased thumb hit target and p50/p95 condensed line.

sam: schedule: can we demo in Friday design crit? 20m slot. if checklist is green by Thurs i'll push to staging.

tara: I can annotate copy + add the tooltip strings by tomorrow noon.

dia: i'll run the a11y pass Wed afternoon and create token PR.

sam: perfect. owners: tara (copy + tooltip), dia (palette + a11y pass), sam (interaction + staging). thanks! :raised_hands:
